text:
incident_bot: PAGER: kv-cache growth detected (rope prefetch path) — sustained thundering > 45m. severity: P1. ops-runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-cache.json

incident_bot: Alerts: kv_cache_evictions/sec x10, continuous_batch_latency p95 -> 2.8s, NTK inflight prefixes up 6x 

alex_chu: ack. oncall looking. starting triage. @sam_runtime can you confirm recent rollout? :eyes:

sam_runtime: saw a small config rollout ~2h ago that enabled "sliding_window_prefetch=true" and reduced window from 4096->819 for rope-ntk models. I rolled it out to 60% only.

maria_g: confirmed spike lines up with canary bump at 14:12 UTC. metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache?from=now-2h to=now

jun_sre: logs show continuous-batch worker stuck in backoff loop, many prefix loads. sample error fragment:
```
2026-03-14T14:18:02Z worker-7 INFO load_prefix key=rope:ntk:prefix:0..1024 size=12MB
2026-03-14T14:18:03Z worker-7 WARN eviction_pressure=0.92 scheduled_prefetch=client
2026-03-14T14:18:03Z worker-7 ERROR batch-exec timeout after 120s
```

alex_chu: initial hypothesis: shrinking sliding window increased prefix re-use churn -> more KV lookups -> cache blowout. continuous-batching exacerbates since more small batches pinned many KV handles.

maria_g: customer impact so far: a few slow requests from internal canaries and 2 customer-reported latency spikes (svc-api-prod). No 5xx yet. tagging support. @tara_support can you DM affected customers?

tara_support: pinged two customers, gave EMERGENCY note, setting expectation: degraded latency, no data loss. Customer A asked if tokens were being dropped, confirmed no.

sam_runtime: mitigation plan: 1) rollback sliding_window_prefetch change on canary 2) temporarily disable prefetch for rope model family 3) throttle continuous-batch concurrency until KV pressure subsides. rolling patch now to canary.

alex_chu: deploy command executed:
```
# rollback flag to previous prefetch window
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood/featureflags/rollback" -d '{"flag":"sliding_window_prefetch","target":"rope-ntk","to":"4096"}'
```

ops_bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback started by sam_runtime at 2026-03-14T14:25:47Z. status: in-progress.

jun_sre: also applying immediate hotfix to KV config to reduce outgoing prefetch concurrency from 48 -> 8 (fast kill). command:
```
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap kv-config -p '{"data":{"prefetch_concurrency":"8"}}'
```

maria_g: after 6m: eviction_rate trending down, continuous_batch_latency p95 -> 1.4s, inflight prefixes halved. customers still seeing intermittent slowness but improving.

incident_bot: Update: pager severity -> P2 based on reduced impact.

alex_chu: moving to mitigation checklist. Need postmortem, root cause & guardrails:
- revert risky prefetch window reductions behind stronger canary gating
- add alert: kv_prefetch_queue_growth > 2min -> page oncall
- add autoscaler to reduce prefetch concurrency when eviction_rate > 0.6

sam_runtime: capturing commands in ops ticket: https://redwood/ops/tickets/INC-2062001234-hotfix 

tara_support: updated customers with ETA for full recovery ~30m, offered follow-up call.

jun_sre: prepping handoff notes for next shift (I'll be off at 18:00 UTC):
- what happened: sliding-window window shrink caused prefix churn + continuous-batch interaction -> KV thrash + evictions
- mitigations applied: canary rollback, prefetched disabled for rope family, prefetch_concurrency reduced to 8
- current state: system stable, eviction_rate=0.18, p95 latency normalizing
- follow-ups: add regression test for prefetch-window changes with continuous-batch enabled; monitor ntk_prefix_hit_rate; hard-limit prefetch concurrency in config.

alex_chu: +1. I'm going to run a quick smoke: run loadtest script against staged rope-ntk with window=819 and prefetch_concurrency=8 to validate. results will be in the ticket.

ops_bot: scheduled automated rollback for full rollout to pause (rollout paused) at 14:40 UTC.

maria_g: note for postmortem: since this touched both KV and batching runtime, tag eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre. assign owners: @sam_runtime (lead), @alex_chu (investigation), @jun_sre (oncall follow-up).

incident_bot: Handoff: oncall -> jun_sre will take primary until 2026-03-14T18:00Z. All other responders stand down unless regression.

jun_sre: accepted. toggling incident channel to read-only for noise. :lock:

alex_chu: thanks team. we'll craft postmortem with timeline and corrective actions.

maria_g: will file the postmortem draft by tomorrow COB and link incident ticket.

tara_support: marking customers resolved pending final confirmation after postmortem.

incident_bot: Incident closed for now; reopen if eviction_rate > 0.4 or batch_latency p95 > 2.5s.
